milestones.title: First preserved public framing
milestones.claim: Public SemeAi and Pletinnya framing is preserved in the selected archive by 2025-07-08.

milestones.title: Living archive language
milestones.claim: A public project post described a living archive for project materials; this is historical architecture language, not storage verification.

milestones.title: Structured architecture language
milestones.claim: A public post described separated directive-core and path-network layers.

milestones.title: First repository in the current public inventory
milestones.claim: SemeAi_ProofOfResonance is the earliest-created non-fork repository in the captured public account inventory.

milestones.title: Silence-as-Control repository
milestones.claim: A public post and first-party repository trace made Silence-as-Control visible as a control-layer principle.

milestones.title: Release-control experiment
milestones.claim: Public project language distinguished generation behavior from release-control behavior; repository history remains experiment authority.

milestones.title: Generation separated from authority
milestones.claim: The public trace explicitly stated that generation is not authority.

milestones.title: Candidate and release decision
milestones.claim: The public trace described candidate production and release as separate runtime decisions.

milestones.title: Local release-control demonstration
milestones.claim: A local Qwen/Ollama demonstration with repository context and a PoR release gate was publicly described.

milestones.title: NEEDS_REVIEW becomes explicit
milestones.claim: A public implementation trace used NEEDS_REVIEW as a separate release-layer state.

milestones.title: Tri-state release vocabulary
milestones.claim: PROCEED / NEEDS_REVIEW / SILENCE was publicly presented as an external release-gate surface.

milestones.title: SemeAi Local Runtime
milestones.claim: A first-party local runtime repository and matching public trace exposed candidate/release separation.

milestones.title: Product Gate repository
milestones.claim: The first-party semeai-gate-basic repository established the bounded SHOW / REVIEW / BLOCK product surface.

milestones.title: Public system repository
milestones.claim: The first-party semeai.tech repository became the public product, evidence, and engineering-book surface.
